sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
Escape Plan in Squid Game is built around a simple yet engaging core gameplay mechanic: accumulating resources and managing player levels to devise an escape plan. Players begin with a basic inmate model and must gather resources such as food, water, and tools to upgrade their player level and unlock new items and abilities. The game's resources are generated through a click-based system, where players must click on the game screen to accumulate resources and progress through the game.

As players progress through the game, they will encounter various obstacles and challenges that require strategic thinking and planning to overcome. These challenges include security lights, police patrols, and rival inmates who can either aid or hinder the player's progress. Players must use their resources and abilities wisely to overcome these challenges and stay one step ahead of the prison authorities.

The game's core gameplay mechanic is complemented by a variety of items and tools that players can use to aid their escape. These items range from basic tools such as a screwdriver and pliers to more advanced items such as a lockpick and a disguise. Players must carefully manage their resources and use these items strategically to overcome obstacles and challenges.

The game's difficulty level increases as players progress through the game, with more complex challenges and obstacles appearing as players gain experience and level up. This ensures that the game remains challenging and engaging throughout, even for experienced players. Overall, the core gameplay mechanic of Escape Plan in Squid Game is engaging, addictive, and easy to learn, making it accessible to players of all ages and skill levels.
